subject: storytime
title: Princess in Black words
about: Princess Magnolia looks like a perfectly proper princess, but when her monster alarm rings she slips away in a black mask and cape to keep the goats safe. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, a chapter a night.

book.author: Shannon Hale and Dean Hale
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A frilly princess with a secret: she is also a monster-chasing hero.
